summary: Inbound referral from Tala who needed help regaining access to a locked-out Instagram account. He was logged out and the account's recovery email is a college address from over a decade ago that he no longer has access to, so he couldn't receive the verification code; he sent a screenshot of the login/verification prompt IG shows him. The phone owner asked for his logins to try alternate recovery methods, but before anything was done he reported that his cybersecurity girlfriend got him back in. Closed out with no service performed and no payment — potential future lead for account recovery work.
key_facts: First outreach landed in his spam folder
Instagram lockout: recovery email is an inaccessible college email from 10+ years ago
No phone change — same device for 5 years
Sent screenshot of the IG verification/lockout prompt (attachment IMG_8778.heic, could not be opened for review)
Was asked to share logins so alternate recovery routes could be tried; never provided them
Self-resolved — his girlfriend (works in cybersecurity) recovered the account
No price quoted, no money exchanged
services_discussed: Instagram account recovery / regaining access to locked-out account
Instagram identity verification when recovery email is inaccessible
